text:
hannah_fin: Heads-up: EU reseller HelixCloud says their April payable is overstated because we applied US sales tax instead of VAT-exempt reseller treatment. They provided invoice HC-APR-26-44 and a portal note. Can billing triage?

omar_billing: pulling the marketplace settlement and our generated payable CSV. Do we have the partner VAT registration id on file?

lucy_partners: partner uploaded their EU VAT ID (DE123456789) on Mar 20 and marked their account as B2B-reseller in the portal. They attached the registration PDF.

omar_billing: looking at ledger rows. We applied tax_code=US_SALES_TAX to lines for HelixCloud for region EU-West-1. Import log shows "info: tax_map defaulted to US_SALES_TAX for partner_id=helix-02". That's not right.

hannah_fin: that's a big problem. Tax treatment changes settlement net payable. Any idea how much?

omar_billing: unit rates look fine. Tax was 20% applied to reseller invoice lines (we included VAT on top instead of zero-rating). Net delta (tax portion) = €18,240. That's the VAT amount they say shouldn't have been charged.

trey_treasury: pre-approve a reversal of the tax charge (refund/credit note) for €18,240 pending verification of VAT ID and audit trail. We'll need the supporting docs in the FIN ticket.

lucy_partners: partner insists they provided VAT ID in time and that portal flag was set to "reseller: true". They attached a screenshot showing the flag. They asked for a corrected invoice, not a credit note, since they need the reversal for their VAT reporting.

omar_billing: checking ingestion pipeline notes. devops-bot shows billing-sync v5.0.0 deployed 2026-04-02T04:02:11Z. There's a change: partner profile sync now pulls VAT flags from the partners service, but a bug in the v5.0.0 migration caused EU region partners to be tagged as "non-eu" when country_code parsing failed (strip whitespace bug). That led to our tax_map choosing default US sales treatment.

devops-bot: deploy: billing-sync v5.0.0 rolled out 2026-04-02T04:02:11Z by deploy-bot. Migration: partner_country normalization added.

hannah_fin: so ingestion mis-tagged the partner region and we misapplied tax. Agreed remediation steps?

omar_billing: propose: (1) verify VAT id for HelixCloud and capture portal proof (done), (2) regenerate reseller_payable CSV with tax_code corrected (zero-rated) and reissue invoice HC-APR-26-44-rev1, (3) if payment already scheduled, treasury to reverse the VAT portion or issue a credit note depending on partner preference, (4) hotfix billing-sync v5.0.1 to fix country_code parsing and add migration rollback for partner tags, (5) add an alert when partner_flag discrepancies >0 after a profile sync.

lucy_partners: HelixCloud prefers corrected invoice (rev1) for their VAT filing; they also asked for an official note confirming we won't apply VAT when valid reseller VAT ID present.

trey_treasury: prefer a corrected invoice as well. For any payments already executed, we'll create a reversing journal for the VAT column and schedule a top-up to zero out the tax portion. Pre-approved for €18,240 pending backfill import. Please attach the partner VAT doc to FIN-3759.

omar_billing: running backfill now to regenerate invoice. Backfill job id bf-2026-04-03-4410. ETA ~12m.

devops-bot: backfill job started: bf-2026-04-03-4410.

omar_billing: backfill complete. import file s3://redwood-billing/reconciliations/2026-04-helixcloud-tax-fix.csv import id imp-2026-04-03-4410. Draft corrected invoice HC-APR-26-44-rev1 attached to FIN-3759. VAT delta confirmed €18,240.

hannah_fin: added partner VAT registration PDF to FIN-3759. Please include a short RCA note for partner communication.

lucy_partners: messaged HelixCloud: "We've identified a partner profile sync bug that misclassified your country code during a migration. We've regenerated your invoice (HC-APR-26-44-rev1) with VAT zero-rated and attached proof. No action required on your end; let us know if you need a signed confirmation." Partner acknowledged and requested the confirmation PO.

devops-bot: deploy: billing-sync hotfix v5.0.1 rolled out 2026-04-03T05:20:02Z. Change: trim whitespace on country_code and add migration verification.

omar_billing: remediation notes: fixed parser bug, re-ran profile sync for all EU reseller partners and flagged 3 partners for manual review (none other had mismatches affecting tax > €1k), regenerated HelixCloud invoice, attached VAT docs to FIN-3759, added unit test and migration rollback.

trey_treasury: treasury note: will process reversal/top-up in next AP run for any already-executed payments. FIN-3759 approved for payment adjustment. Controller sign-off required on GL entries.

hannah_fin: RCA summary for FIN-3759: billing-sync v5.0.0 migration introduced a whitespace parsing regression for country_code causing EU reseller partners to be misclassified; tax mapping defaulted to US sales tax and VAT was incorrectly applied. Impact: HelixCloud VAT overcharge €18,240. Remediation: regenerated invoice (rev1), attached VAT ID, deployed hotfix v5.0.1, re-synced partner profiles, added migration checks and alerting, created FIN ticket for audit trail.

lucy_partners: HelixCloud confirmed receipt of rev1 invoice and will update their VAT filings. They asked for a brief joint statement for their auditors; I'll prepare that and attach to FIN-3759.

omar_billing: leaving thread open until treasury posts reversal/top-up and controller signs off GL entries.
